intro.description: This form is for Bangladeshi taxpayers living abroad who cannot use a Bangladesh-registered mobile number for eReturn special registration.

documents.sectionHelper: Upload clear and readable copies in PDF, JPG, JPEG, or PNG format. Maximum size is 2 MB per file.

nid.label: Copy of NID/Smart ID
nid.helper: Upload clear JPG, PNG or PDF files. Maximum file size: 2 MB each. Maximum 2 files.

passport.label: Copy of Bio-page of passport
passport.helper: Upload the passport page containing the holder's photo and personal details. Maximum file size: 2 MB.

visa.label: Copy of Visa page of residing country
visa.helper: Upload the current visa or residence page, if available. Maximum file size: 2 MB.

departure.label: Copy of Passport page with latest departure seal as proof of departure from Bangladesh
departure.helper: Upload the passport page containing the latest Bangladesh departure seal. Maximum file size: 2 MB.
